messages:
maria: Quick sync — adding a short geo footnote for EU/CA residency. Need SDK snippet and migration guide edits. cc @kim @jason :wave:

kim: Legal prefers the word "processed" instead of "routed" and wants an opt-in note in the migration guide. I can get a one-line approved variant by EOD.

jason: I'll add REDWOOD_REGION env var example and a tiny troubleshooting FAQ about fallback.

henry: I'll update JS + curl samples. Example: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`

henry: Fallback behavior will be documented: server may return 503 + header `X-Redwood-Fallback: global` when region unavailable.

l10n-bot: created T-900 ("geo residency footnote") with context: "short legal sentence + link".

eva: l10n note — keep the legal sentence as a single translatable string so translators can move it into the right spot.

maria: Actions: kim get final legal line, henry update SDK snippets and add fallback example, jason add migration-guide opt-in + env var, eva coordinate translations when T-900 is ready.

kim: Legal approved final wording: "Content may be processed in regional infrastructure based on customer residency settings. Customers with strict in-country residency should use Redwood Private. See: /legal/data-residency". I'll paste this in the PR.

jason: Migration guide PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/12910 — includes env var, FAQ entry, and checklist.

henry: Docs PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/12879 — JS + curl snippets, header alias note, fallback comment. Requesting review from @maria and @kim.

maria: I'll review both PRs this afternoon. Please include T-900 in PR descriptions so l10n is triggered automatically.

henry: Will do. Monitoring for post-merge feedback. :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks everyone — closing thread after merges and linking PRs in the docs checklist.
